The workflow metro map and the four experimental-setup panels are hand-authored SVGs; this
notebook also composes them into one integrated figure (wet lab on top, analysis below) in
`manuscript/figure_sources/`. This notebook renders each SVG to a vector PDF and a PNG
preview with headless Chrome and writes a checksum table, so that a reviewed version is
reproducible from its source. The SVGs carry live text and named layers and no baked-in
panel letters or titles, so the panels can be composed with the metro map into one figure
in Illustrator; edit them directly, then rerun this notebook into a new output directory.

Run from the repository root:

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh manuscript/build_schematic_figures.qmd /absolute/new/output/directory
```

Chrome is used because it keeps vectors and live text in the PDF; `rsvg-convert` is not
available on the analysis machine. The canvas size is read from each SVG's `viewBox`.

```{r}
#| label: render-schematics
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
out <- if (length(args)) args[[1]] else stop("Give a new output directory")
if (dir.exists(out)) stop("Use a new output directory to preserve versions")
dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE)

chrome <- "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
if (!file.exists(chrome)) chrome <- Sys.which("google-chrome")
if (!nzchar(chrome)) stop("Chrome not found")

sources <- c(
  `study-analysis-workflow` = "manuscript/figure_sources/workflow_metro.svg",
  `experimental-setup-reactor` = "manuscript/figure_sources/experimental_setup_reactor.svg",
  `experimental-setup-cleaning-event` = "manuscript/figure_sources/experimental_setup_cleaning-event.svg",
  `experimental-setup-sampling-design` = "manuscript/figure_sources/experimental_setup_sampling-design.svg",
  `experimental-setup-tmp` = "manuscript/figure_sources/experimental_setup_tmp.svg"
)

render_svg <- function(svg, stem) {
  svg <- normalizePath(svg, mustWork = TRUE)
  vb <- regmatches(readLines(svg, n = 3), regexpr('viewBox="[^"]+"', readLines(svg, n = 3)))
  dims <- as.numeric(strsplit(sub('viewBox="', "", sub('"$', "", vb[1])), " ")[[1]])[3:4]
  wrap <- file.path(out, paste0(stem, "_wrap.html"))
  writeLines(sprintf(
    '<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>@page{size:%dpx %dpx;margin:0}html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff}img{display:block;width:%dpx;height:%dpx}</style></head><body><img src="file://%s"></body></html>',
    dims[1], dims[2], dims[1], dims[2], svg), wrap)
  system2(chrome, c("--headless=new", "--disable-gpu", "--hide-scrollbars",
    sprintf("--window-size=%d,%d", dims[1], dims[2]),
    paste0("--screenshot=", shQuote(file.path(out, paste0(stem, ".png")))),
    shQuote(paste0("file://", wrap))), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)
  system2(chrome, c("--headless=new", "--disable-gpu", "--no-pdf-header-footer",
    paste0("--print-to-pdf=", shQuote(file.path(out, paste0(stem, ".pdf")))),
    shQuote(paste0("file://", wrap))), stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)
  unlink(wrap)
  target <- file.path(out, paste0(stem, ".svg"))
  if (normalizePath(target, mustWork = FALSE) != svg) invisible(file.copy(svg, target))
}
for (stem in names(sources)) render_svg(sources[[stem]], stem)

# Integrated figure: wet lab on top (two rows), analysis metro map below. Each panel SVG is
# nested unchanged as an inner <svg> at its composition position; panel letters are added
# here, never in the sources.
inner_svg <- function(path) {
  txt <- paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
  vb <- regmatches(txt, regexpr('viewBox="[^"]+"', txt))
  body <- sub("^.*?<svg[^>]*>", "", txt)
  body <- sub("</svg>\\s*$", "", body)
  list(viewBox = sub('viewBox="([^"]+)"', "\\1", vb), body = body)
}
layout <- data.frame(
  stem = c("experimental-setup-reactor", "experimental-setup-cleaning-event",
           "experimental-setup-sampling-design", "experimental-setup-tmp",
           "study-analysis-workflow"),
  letter = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"),
  x = c(40, 740, 40, 870, 20),
  y = c(50, 50, 480, 480, 1010),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
parts <- character(0)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(layout))) {
  p <- inner_svg(sources[[layout$stem[i]]])
  dims <- as.numeric(strsplit(p$viewBox, " ")[[1]])[3:4]
  parts <- c(parts,
    sprintf('<text x="%d" y="%d" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#2F2F2F">%s</text>',
            layout$x[i], layout$y[i] - 12, layout$letter[i]),
    sprintf('<svg id="panel-%s" x="%d" y="%d" width="%d" height="%d" viewBox="%s">%s</svg>',
            layout$letter[i], layout$x[i], layout$y[i], dims[1], dims[2], p$viewBox, p$body))
}
W <- 2000; H <- 2160
integrated <- c(
  sprintf('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">', W, H),
  "<!-- Integrated wet-lab and analysis figure: generated by manuscript/build_schematic_figures.qmd from the panel sources in manuscript/figure_sources/. Edit the panels, not this file. -->",
  sprintf('<rect x="0" y="0" width="%d" height="%d" fill="#FFFFFF"/>', W, H),
  parts, "</svg>")
writeLines(integrated, file.path(out, "integrated-wetlab-workflow.svg"))
render_svg(file.path(out, "integrated-wetlab-workflow.svg"), "integrated-wetlab-workflow")

files <- list.files(out, full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(files) == 3 * (length(sources) + 1))
write.table(data.frame(file = basename(files), bytes = file.info(files)$size,
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(files))), file.path(out, "output_checksums.md5.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
